figurative_meaning_en: similar to a crooked eye, implying an envious or malicious sidelong glance
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বাঁকা নজরে আমার সাফল্য সহ্য হচ্ছে না।
example_sentences_in_english: She can't tolerate my success with her crooked gaze.
He looks at everyone with a sidelong, envious glance.
note: Often associated with superstitious beliefs about jealousy causing harm
